what: cost of every published quantization rung, at query time (batch 1)
runtime: @huggingface/transformers in Node (ONNX), the runtime zoteus ships
failure_note: fp16/q4/q4f16/bnb4 not swept: fp16 fails on the CPU provider for both other models tested, and the rest are below the floor ratified for ticket 0240.
caveats: Warm runs only. A cold run of this model, download in flight, read 364,8 MB at q8 and 453,5 MB at uint8 against warm 410,2 and 404,9 — a 45-49 MB error in both directions. Cold RSS is not comparable to warm and must never be mixed into a table.

One process per rung, warm cache: RSS is the total a fresh server process pays (ONNX Runtime and Node included), not the marginal cost of the weights. Loading a second model into a live process costs less, because the runtime is already there.
load_ms is warm — the weights were already downloaded. A first run also pays the download in the size column.
download_mb is the published ONNX file size on the Hugging Face repo, external data files included.
Cost, not quality. Read beside the fidelity ladder, never instead of it.
why_this_model: Surfaced by a candidate search over open, small, genuinely multilingual embedders with ONNX published under the filenames transformers.js resolves. The standout on paper: 97,4M parameters, 384 dimensions, 32k context, Apache-2.0 on both the original ibm-granite repo and this ONNX mirror, and the only candidate found carrying an apples-to-apples multilingual retrieval score.
claimed_quality: 60,3 on MTEB Multilingual Retrieval over 18 tasks, against 50,9 for multilingual-e5-small on the same benchmark. CLAIMED BY IBM in the model's own README, which is also the source of the e5-small comparison figure — a vendor reporting its own model beside a rival. Not independently verified and not measured here. Ticket 0240 measures recall on this repo's corpus; until then this number selects what to measure, never what to ship.
verdict: Cheapest multilingual model measured, and only just. 407,8 MB at q8 against multilingual-e5-small's 419,5 MB — 11,7 MB apart, where repeated measurement of a single cell spans 2,5-6,9 MB. Treat them as close, not as ranked. Both sit far above nomic-768's 234,2 MB and both exceed CONSTRAINTS.md C3's 300 MB, which the 2026-08-29 ruling resolves in R7's favour.
predictor_failed: This model is why the vocab x dim resident-memory predictor was retracted. It predicted 302 MB from a 263,7 MB embedding table; the measurement is 407,8 MB, off by 106 MB. The predictor had matched e5-small to a tenth of a megabyte, having been calibrated on it. First out-of-sample test, first failure — see dtype-ladder-multilingual-e5-small.json.

repeated_measurement.what: q8 RSS over five fresh processes, warm
repeated_measurement.note: Warm single-run RSS is good to about 10 MB. Smaller differences are not differences.
